items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Keanu, Flage, and Frankie and Johnny. That's right. And he had Pops Foster and Zutty Singleton on drums.

ctx.x: Is that right? I didn't know that.
Keanu, Flage, and Frankie and Johnny. That's right. And he had Pops Foster and Zutty Singleton on drums. Uh-huh. Two Cornets, Amos White and Sidney Deadzvins.
I believe Norman Basin's on it too. Uh-huh.
